Hiragana

Learn hiragana and katakana, including dakuten, handakuten, yōon and loanword sounds, or switch to the Russian Cyrillic alphabet.

Small っ / ッ (sokuon) doubles the next consonant — compare きて (kite, "come") with きって (kitte, "stamp"). It only works combined with another kana, so it isn't quizzed on its own.
